headline: Camera recording runs around the clock, Settings search finds deeper pages, and Marketplace updates install straight away
summary: Camera recording can now save footage from each camera in short segments to a folder, an external disk, a Windows share or an SSH server, and a day timeline shows where footage is and where it has gaps. Settings search also finds pages that sit one step inside a card. Backup hosting gets a clearer form for images and ports, a bounded way to enter Raspberry Pi addresses, and safer resume and upload steps.
summary_yue: 鏡頭錄影而家可以將每部鏡頭嘅片段，分成短片存去本機資料夾、外置磁碟、Windows 共享或者 SSH 伺服器，一條當日時間線就會顯示邊度有片、邊度有缺口。設定搜尋亦會搵到喺卡入面再深一層嘅頁面。備份託管嘅映像同連接埠表格更清楚，樹莓派地址可以有限度咁輸入，續做同上載嘅步驟亦都穩陣咗。

highlights.title: Settings search finds pages inside the cards
highlights.what: Settings search now also offers pages that sit one step inside a card, such as Camera recording under System. Choose a result and the page opens directly. The camera recording page also opens before any recording destination exists: it shows an empty state with an add button instead of an unknown command message, and it stays listed in Settings so the first setup can start from the page itself.
highlights.what_yue: 設定搜尋而家連卡入面再深一層嘅頁面都會列出嚟，例如系統入面嘅鏡頭錄影。揀咗結果就直接開嗰版。未有錄影目的地之前，鏡頭錄影頁都會顯示空白狀態同新增掣，唔會再彈「Unknown command.」，而且設定入面一直都有呢版，第一次設定可以直接喺頁面度開始。
highlights.why: Settings search only checked the top-level cards, so a page one step further in could never be found.
try: Type "camera" in the search box.
Choose Camera recording from the results and see the page open.
Press Start again to clear the search and the page.

highlights.title: Camera recording runs around the clock with a day timeline
highlights.what: Camera recording saves each camera in short MP4 segments to a folder or disk here, an external disk, a Windows share, or an SSH server over SFTP or SCP. A guided setup tests the connection for real before anything is saved, then asks for the cameras and the limits. Settings, System, Camera recording lists every destination with its cameras and any problems. The camera view gains a timeline of the day under the player, showing recorded footage, gaps and the camera's events. Choosing a moment plays the recording from there, with seek, speed and download.
highlights.what_yue: 鏡頭錄影會將每部鏡頭分成短嘅 MP4 片段，存去本機嘅資料夾或者磁碟、外置磁碟、Windows 共享，或者透過 SFTP 同 SCP 存去 SSH 伺服器。引導式設定喺保存之前會真係測試連線，然後先問你要邊啲鏡頭同上限。設定、系統、鏡頭錄影會列出每個目的地、佢嘅鏡頭同問題。鏡頭畫面嘅播放器下面多咗一條當日時間線，有錄到嘅片段、缺口同鏡頭嘅事件。揀一個時間就會由嗰度播，仲可以快進、調速同下載。
highlights.why: A camera is only useful if its footage can be looked back at, and it helps to see at a glance where the footage has gaps.
try: Choose a moment on the day timeline.
Use the event filter to show only one kind of event.
Change the speed and see the playback label update.

highlights.title: Marketplace updates install without the panel warning
highlights.what: Installing an update of something the Marketplace already installed no longer needs the panel warning to be accepted first, so updates from Settings, automations and scripts install straight away. The warning still guards adding something new from the panel. The panel also opens straight on the page you asked for, instead of behind the warning screen. If the server refuses an install, the update card and the activity tray now say that the update did not start, that nothing was installed, and why.
highlights.what_yue: 而家更新返 Marketplace 已經裝咗嘅嘢，唔使先喺面板撳「我明白」就可以即刻裝，設定、自動化同腳本嘅更新都一樣。加新嘢嘅時候先至會擋住，要先睇清楚警告。面板亦會直接開你要嘅頁，唔使先過警告畫面。伺服器拒絕安裝嘅時候，更新卡同活動列會話明更新未開始、冇裝到任何嘢，同埋原因。
highlights.why: Updates failed for anyone who had never opened the Marketplace panel and accepted its warning.
try: Press Update on the item that is already installed and see it install.
Choose the new item while the warning is not yet accepted.
Tick the warning, then install the new item.

highlights.title: Phone and narrow-screen layouts stop cutting text
highlights.what: Several screens now fit a phone. The dashboard tools subtitle wraps, and the Make phone friendly button sits under its text at its own width. The automation tools sheet fills its space on a phone instead of stopping short. The save bar hides its hint when it is narrow, so the status is no longer cut to a few letters. At 320 px the automation editor bar shows only the icons of Run now, Check and Dry run, each with a spoken label, and the History toolbar wraps so the day navigator stays on screen. The Steps tool now shows its breakpoint dots, and English text on a right-to-left page keeps its own reading order.
highlights.what_yue: 多個畫面而家都可以放入手機度。儀表板工具嘅副題識得轉行，「Make phone friendly」掣喺文字下面用自己嘅闊度。自動化工具面板喺手機上會填滿應有嘅位置。儲存列窄嘅時候會收埋提示，狀態字唔會再被斬到得幾個字。320 px 嘅自動化編輯列，Run now、Check 同 Dry run 只顯示圖示，但有讀得出嘅標籤；歷史頁工具列會轉行，日期導覽留喺畫面入面。步驟工具而家會顯示中斷點紅點。由右至左嘅頁面入面，英文字都會保持自己嘅閱讀次序。
highlights.why: On a phone, some text and buttons ran off the edge or were cut short, and the save status could not be read.
try: Set the width to Phone (320 px) and look at the save bar.
Switch between Before and After to compare the status text.
Press Start again to return to the first state.

highlights.title: Backup hosting sends the image and port you choose
highlights.what: The backup hosting form now sends the Docker and SSH image tags you pick, and the Docker, SSH and VirtualBox ports, to the hosting service. Fields you leave empty keep their defaults. Zero, malformed and unsupported ports are refused before anything starts, and invalid choices are rejected with a message rather than being quietly ignored.
highlights.what_yue: 備份託管表格而家會將你揀嘅 Docker 同 SSH 映像版本，連同 Docker、SSH 同 VirtualBox 嘅連接埠，真正送去託管服務。留空嘅欄位維持預設值。零、格式錯誤或者唔支援嘅連接埠，喺開始之前就會被拒絕，並且會有訊息講明原因，唔會靜靜哋當冇咗。
highlights.why: The image and port fields looked like choices, but they did not reach the hosting service, so a setting on the screen could be ignored.
try: Enter 0 in a port field and press Start, then read the error.
Enter a valid port and pick an image tag, then press Start.
Read the summary to see the values that would be sent.

highlights.title: Raspberry Pi backup addresses can be entered and retried
highlights.what: The backup workflow accepts up to sixteen explicit private IPv4 addresses that you type in yourself. Ranges and public addresses are rejected. Form values stay in the window only. A device job that is waiting can be retried with its existing request and handle, so it does not start over. Searching for devices gives an address list, and it does not scan the whole subnet.
highlights.what_yue: 備份流程最多接受十六個你自己指定嘅私人 IPv4 地址。地址範圍同公網地址會被拒絕，表格資料只暫存喺視窗入面。正在等候嘅裝置工作，可以沿用原本嘅要求同識別碼再試一次，唔使由頭開始。搵裝置只會列出你畫定嘅地址，唔會掃遍成個子網。
highlights.why: The workflow should only contact addresses you gave it, and a waiting device job should not need to be started again.
try: Press Use a pretend address, then add it.
Type a range (an address followed by a slash and a number) and read the refusal.
Add addresses until the limit of sixteen is reached, then press Retry.

highlights.title: Resume a backup job after restart, after checking its SSH host
highlights.what: A backup job that this computer owns can be resumed after a restart. The Resume action appears only when the backend says this computer owns the job. Resuming reuses the job's original request, archive and target, and keeps its saved image and port. Before it resumes, the saved SSH host is shown for native confirmation: declining, or a host that does not match, starts nothing. An optional key is read from a masked field and cleared at once. An expired upload can be resumed only by its matching unfinished job, and cancelling waits until the current step has settled.
highlights.what_yue: 屬於呢部電腦嘅備份工作，重啟之後可以繼續。只有後端話呢部機擁有嗰個工作，先會出現繼續掣。繼續嘅時候會沿用原本嘅要求、封存檔同目標，已儲存嘅映像同連接埠唔會被覆蓋。繼續之前，已儲存嘅 SSH 主機會經原生確認畫面俾你核對，拒絕或者主機唔啱，就唔會開始任何嘢。可選金鑰由遮罩欄位讀取，讀完即刻清除。過期嘅上載只可以畀對應嘅未完成工作續用。取消會等到目前嘅步驟收尾先算。
highlights.why: After a restart an unfinished backup could not be picked up safely, and starting it again could create a second, confused copy.
try: Press Resume on the job marked as owned by this computer.
Decline the SSH host and see that nothing starts.
Approve the same host, then resume the job.

highlights.title: Backup upload waits until setup is ready and the receiver is idle
highlights.what: Before a backup upload starts, the app waits for the backup setup page to be ready, using a read-only check that gives up after a set time. Then it waits until the receiver reports that it is idle. Uploads and restores are sent once and are never retried automatically. A failed attempt shows only the HTTP status and a fixed stage name in the job record. A later attempt or a success clears the old details.
highlights.what_yue: 備份上載開始之前，程式會等備份設定頁就緒，用嘅係只讀嘅檢查，等到限定時間就放棄。之後仲會等接收器講自己閒置，先會上載。上載同還原只會送一次，唔會自動重試。失敗嘅時候，工作紀錄淨係留低 HTTP 狀態同一個固定嘅階段名。下次嘗試或者成功，就會清走舊資料。
highlights.why: A preparation service answering the door does not mean the backup system has finished moving in, and a busy receiver can make an upload fail.
try: Leave Setup ready off and see that Upload stays disabled.
Turn on Receiver idle as well, then press Upload.
Choose a failing result, read the diagnostics, then press Start again.
